description: A sheet, and the long way

participation.context: Stood, listened, and put nothing on the sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought him to the Hall and took him away again before the play.
participation.name: George Bryan

relations.note: the walk west, and the play not his

story.body: You listened while a client, charged for a short sheet, said the long of it anyway. The two shillings were his. You left with Bryan before the clerk read it back. You were not cast in the afternoon.

relations.note: the walk west, and the play not his

title: Stood and heard the grievance said again

participation.context: His shoulder is at the edge. His face is not turned toward the picture.
participation.name: George Bryan

relations.note: they stood in the same hall

story.body: The picture is the Hall, the caps, and the parchment. Your face is not in it.

relations.note: they stood in the same hall

participation.context: Stood in the door and kept the comedy off her stair.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted thirty-three shillings and sent him out of her feet.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

relations.note: the stair is hers to count

story.body: You stayed in the parlour door. Margery named the house in one line and went back to counting. You did not turn the afternoon into a billing.

relations.note: the stair is hers to count

title: Heard Margery's thirty-three shillings from the parlour door
